description_target.target_text: Count the orange(7)s on the top row to choose the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd object by area rank. Use the corner maroon(9) to choose the rotation (same convention as medium_n06). Then place the transformed chosen object centered inside the cyan(8) frame and clear everything else.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; A maroon(9) corner picks a rotation (TL none, TR cw, BR 180, BL ccw)
 ;; and the count of orange(7) marks on the top row picks a rank (1-3).
 ;; Strip those marks, find the largest hollow cyan(8) frame, rank the
 ;; other objects by size (ties: bbox order), and place the rank-th
 ;; smallest — rotated — centered inside the frame on a blank canvas.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define code
       (cond ((= (at g 0 0) 9) 0)
             ((= (at g 0 (- w 1)) 9) 1)
             ((= (at g (- h 1) (- w 1)) 9) 2)
             ((= (at g (- h 1) 0) 9) 3)
             (else 0)))
     (define rank
       (max 1 (min 3 (count-if (lambda (c) (= (at g 0 c) 7))
                               (range 0 w)))))
     (define clean  ;; drop the corner 9s and the top-row 7s
       (for/fold ((out g))
                 ((p (in-list (cons (list 0 0)
                                    (cons (list 0 (- w 1))
                                          (cons (list (- h 1) 0)
                                                (cons (list (- h 1) (- w 1))
                                                      (for/list ((c (in-range w)))
                                                        (list 0 c)))))))))
         (let ((v (at out (first p) (second p))))
           (if (or (and (= v 9) (or (= (first p) 0) (= (first p) (- h 1)))
                        (or (= (second p) 0) (= (second p) (- w 1))))
                   (and (= v 7) (= (first p) 0)))
               (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 0)
               out))))
     (define (frame? o)  ;; hollow rectangle outline, at least 3x3
       (and (>= (obj-h o) 3) (>= (obj-w o) 3)
            (= (obj-size o) (- (* 2 (+ (obj-h o) (obj-w o))) 4))
            (all? (lambda (p) (or (= (first p) (obj-r1 o))
                                  (= (first p) (obj-r2 o))
                                  (= (second p) (obj-c1 o))
                                  (= (second p) (obj-c2 o))))
                  (obj-cells o))))
     (define frame
       (pick-max (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) 8) (frame? o)))
                         (objects clean 0))
                 (lambda (o) (* (- (obj-h o) 2) (- (obj-w o) 2)))))
     (define scene (erase-cells clean (obj-cells frame) 0))
     (define comps
       (sort (filter (lambda (o)
                       (not (member? (obj-color o) (list 7 8 9))))
                     (objects scene 0))
             (lambda (a b)
               (if (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))
                   (let loop ((xs (list (obj-r1 a) (obj-c1 a)
                                        (obj-r2 a) (obj-c2 a)))
                              (ys (list (obj-r1 b) (obj-c1 b)
                                        (obj-r2 b) (obj-c2 b))))
                     (cond ((empty? xs) #f)
                           ((< (first xs) (first ys)) #t)
                           ((> (first xs) (first ys)) #f)
                           (else (loop (rest xs) (rest ys)))))
                   (< (obj-size a) (obj-size b))))))
     (define chosen (list-ref comps (- rank 1)))
     (define sub
       (let ((raw (subgrid scene (obj-r1 chosen) (obj-c1 chosen)
                           (obj-r2 chosen) (obj-c2 chosen))))
         (cond ((= code 1) (rotate-cw raw))
               ((= code 2) (rotate-180 raw))
               ((= code 3) (rotate-ccw raw))
               (else raw))))
     (let ((sr (+ (obj-r1 frame) 1
                  (max 0 (quotient (- (obj-h frame) 2 (rows sub)) 2))))
           (sc (+ (obj-c1 frame) 1
                  (max 0 (quotient (- (obj-w frame) 2 (cols sub)) 2)))))
       (for*/fold ((acc (paint-cells (empty-grid h w 0)
                                     (obj-cells frame) 8)))
                  ((r (in-range (rows sub))) (c (in-range (cols sub))))
         (let ((v (at sub r c)))
           (if (and (> v 0)
                    (< (+ sr r) (obj-r2 frame))
                    (< (+ sc c) (obj-c2 frame)))
               (set-cell acc (+ sr r) (+ sc c) v)
               acc)))))))
